name: Event — Invitation
summary: Centred and airy, for dinners and Eid. The only template that does not end in the black CTA bar — a black slab would undo the airiness.

palette.note: All type is unboxed here, so --flyer-ink carries the whole flyer rather than one line of it.

slots.name: logo
slots.label: Masjid logo
slots.help: Small, at the top. Use a dark version — the ground here is pale. Omit rather than stretch a low-resolution file.

slots.name: eyebrow
slots.label: Invitation line
slots.help: Set in spaced caps. Keep it short — long text at this letter-spacing wraps badly.

slots.name: arabic
slots.label: Arabic line
slots.help: Optional. Rendered right-to-left in a system Naskh face; check the export before sending.

slots.name: subtitle
slots.label: Subtitle
slots.help: Who is hosting, or what the evening is for.

slots.name: contact
slots.label: Contact (phone number)
slots.help: Ask which number to use — the events/RSVP line is not the food-order line. Sits on a ruled line here, not in a black bar.
